item.title: XPENG X9 MPV Nabs 5-Star Euro NCAP Safety Rating
item.description: The Xpeng X9 has earned the maximum five-star rating from the European New Car Assessment Program (Euro NCAP). This recognition highlights the all-electric luxury MPV’s advanced safety engineering, with scores of 91 percent in both Crash Protection and Post-Crash Safety. Read More »
